exampleSentences.en: Her doctor recommended regular cancer screening.
exampleSentences.zh: 她的醫師建議定期接受癌症篩檢。

exampleSentences.en: Early detection significantly improves survival rates for some cancers.
exampleSentences.zh: 早期發現可大幅提升某些癌症的存活率。

cancer.mnemonicHint: cancerous 是 cancer 的形容詞形式。

exampleSentences.en: The storm caused a brief power outage.
exampleSentences.zh: 暴風雨造成短暫停電。

exampleSentences.en: Rapid urbanization caused substantial changes in land use.
exampleSentences.zh: 快速都市化造成土地利用的重大變化。

caused.mnemonicHint: cause 原因 + ed，表示已經造成。

exampleSentences.en: I could see the onion cell clearly through the microscope.
exampleSentences.zh: 我透過顯微鏡清楚看見了洋蔥細胞。

exampleSentences.en: Every cell contains molecular machinery essential to life.
exampleSentences.zh: 每個細胞都含有生命所必需的分子機制。

cell.mnemonicHint: cell 像一個小格子，可指細胞或小室。

exampleSentences.en: I replaced the dead cells in the flashlight.
exampleSentences.zh: 我更換了手電筒裡沒電的電池。

exampleSentences.en: Stem cells can develop into several specialized types of tissue.
exampleSentences.zh: 幹細胞能發育成數種特化的組織類型。

cells.mnemonicHint: cells 和 sells 同音；顯微鏡下看到的是 cells，商店做的是 sells。

exampleSentences.en: Sharing a coworker's private message was a censurable breach of trust.
exampleSentences.zh: 公開同事的私人訊息是應受譴責的背信行為。

exampleSentences.en: The ethics committee deemed the undisclosed conflict of interest censurable conduct.
exampleSentences.zh: 倫理委員會認定未揭露利益衝突屬於應受譴責的行為。

censurable.mnemonicHint: censure 譴責加 able，值得責備

exampleSentences.en: Let's meet at the information center inside the station.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們在車站內的服務中心碰面吧。

exampleSentences.en: The debate places individual privacy at the center of digital policy.
exampleSentences.zh: 這場辯論將個人隱私置於數位政策的核心。

center.mnemonicHint: center 就在中央；central 是中央的，兩者共享 cent-。

exampleSentences.en: Breakfast became chaotic when the toaster started smoking.
exampleSentences.zh: 烤麵包機開始冒煙後，早餐時間變得一片混亂。

exampleSentences.en: Researchers observed chaotic fluctuations in the unregulated energy market.
exampleSentences.zh: 研究人員觀察到未受監管的能源市場出現混亂波動。

exampleSentences.en: She was circumspect about sharing personal details online.
exampleSentences.zh: 她對在網上分享個人資料非常謹慎。

exampleSentences.en: Investors should remain circumspect when evaluating high-yield opportunities.
exampleSentences.zh: 投資者在評估高收益機會時應保持謹慎。

circumspect.mnemonicHint: circum(around) + spect(look) → 四處環顧 → 謹慎的

exampleSentences.en: These cities are easy to reach by train.
exampleSentences.zh: 搭火車很容易抵達這些城市。

exampleSentences.en: Coastal cities face increasing risks from rising sea levels.
exampleSentences.zh: 沿海城市面臨海平面上升所帶來的日益增加的風險。

cities.mnemonicHint: city 的 y 變 i 再加 es，成為複數 cities。

exampleSentences.en: The clamorous crowd outside the stadium kept our baby awake.
exampleSentences.zh: 體育場外喧鬧的人群吵得我們的寶寶睡不著。

exampleSentences.en: Newspaper archives document the clamorous protests that preceded the reform.
exampleSentences.zh: 報紙檔案記錄了改革前喧騰的抗議活動。

clamorous.mnemonicHint: clamor 是吵鬧聲，clamorous 很喧囂

exampleSentences.en: The instructions were clear and easy to follow.
exampleSentences.zh: 說明很清楚，也容易遵循。

exampleSentences.en: The data reveal a clear association between income and health.
exampleSentences.zh: 資料顯示收入與健康之間有明確關聯。

clear.mnemonicHint: clear 像清澈玻璃，能清楚看穿。

exampleSentences.en: The island has a warm, humid climate.
exampleSentences.zh: 這座島嶼氣候溫暖潮濕。

exampleSentences.en: Climate change is altering the frequency of extreme weather events.
exampleSentences.zh: 氣候變遷正在改變極端天氣事件的頻率。

climate.mnemonicHint: climate 是長期氣候；weather 是短期天氣。

exampleSentences.en: This color looks warmer in sunlight.
exampleSentences.zh: 這個顏色在陽光下看起來更暖。

exampleSentences.en: Leaf color can indicate changes in nutrient availability.
exampleSentences.zh: 葉片顏色可顯示養分供應的變化。

color.mnemonicHint: colorful 是充滿 color 顏色的。

exampleSentences.en: The city held a ceremony to commemorate the victims.
exampleSentences.zh: 城市舉行了儀式紀念受害者。

exampleSentences.en: Monuments that commemorate historical events shape collective memory.
exampleSentences.zh: 紀念歷史事件的紀念碑塑造了集體記憶。

commemorate.mnemonicHint: com(together) + memor(remember) + ate → 一起記住 → 紀念

exampleSentences.en: It is common to carry an umbrella here in summer.
exampleSentences.zh: 在這裡，夏天隨身帶傘很常見。

exampleSentences.en: The two species share a common ancestor but occupy different habitats.
exampleSentences.zh: 這兩個物種擁有共同祖先，卻棲息於不同環境。

common.mnemonicHint: common 可指大家共有的共同事物，也可指到處都有、很常見。

exampleSentences.en: The governor granted commutations to nonviolent offenders.
exampleSentences.zh: 州長對非暴力罪犯給予減刑。

exampleSentences.en: Sentence commutations raise questions about justice equity.
exampleSentences.zh: 減刑引發關於司法公平性的問題。

commutations.mnemonicHint: com + mut(change) + ations → 改變 → 減刑

exampleSentences.en: I found my missing keys in the backpack's front compartment.
exampleSentences.zh: 我在背包前方的隔層找到遺失的鑰匙。

exampleSentences.en: Each sealed compartment maintained a different temperature during the experiment.
exampleSentences.zh: 實驗期間，每個密封隔間都維持不同的溫度。

compartment.mnemonicHint: com 加 part，把整體分成隔間

exampleSentences.en: Make sure the charger is compatible with your phone model.
exampleSentences.zh: 確保充電器與你的手機型號相容。

exampleSentences.en: Economic growth must be compatible with environmental sustainability.
exampleSentences.zh: 經濟成長必須與環境永續相容。

compatible.mnemonicHint: com(together) + pat(suffer/feel) + ible → 能共處的 → 相容的

exampleSentences.en: Red wine is the perfect complement to steak.
exampleSentences.zh: 紅酒是牛排的完美搭配。

exampleSentences.en: Online learning can complement traditional classroom instruction.
exampleSentences.zh: 線上學習可以補充傳統課堂教學。

complement.mnemonicHint: com(together) + ple(fill) + ment → 填滿補齊 → 補充。注意：compliment 是讚美

exampleSentences.en: All employees must ensure compliance with the new safety protocols.
exampleSentences.zh: 所有員工必須確保遵守新的安全規程。

exampleSentences.en: Regulatory compliance is a critical concern for fintech startups.
exampleSentences.zh: 法規合規是金融科技新創公司的關鍵關切。

compliance.mnemonicHint: com(together) + pli(fold) + ance → 配合要求 → 遵從

exampleSentences.en: Inviting extra guests will complicate our seating plan.
exampleSentences.zh: 邀請更多客人會讓我們的座位安排變得複雜。

exampleSentences.en: Missing baseline data may complicate the interpretation of treatment effects.
exampleSentences.zh: 缺少基準資料可能會使治療效果的解釋更加複雜。

complicate.mnemonicHint: plic 是摺，摺很多層就複雜

exampleSentences.en: The surgery went well but there were complications.
exampleSentences.zh: 手術順利但出現了併發症。

exampleSentences.en: Legal complications delayed the merger by months.
exampleSentences.zh: 法律問題使合併推遲了數月。

complications.mnemonicHint: com + plic(fold) + ations → 很多層折疊 → 複雜化

exampleSentences.en: The cashier gave me a compliment on my handmade scarf.
exampleSentences.zh: 收銀員稱讚了我手工做的圍巾。

exampleSentences.en: The discourse analysis treats each compliment as a form of positive politeness.
exampleSentences.zh: 話語分析將每一句讚美視為積極禮貌的一種形式。

compliment.mnemonicHint: compliment 有 i，I praise you 我稱讚你

exampleSentences.en: The mechanic replaced a damaged component in our air conditioner.
exampleSentences.zh: 技師更換了我們冷氣機裡受損的零件。

exampleSentences.en: Sleep quality emerged as a key component of cognitive performance.
exampleSentences.zh: 睡眠品質成為認知表現的一項關鍵要素。

component.mnemonicHint: com 加 pon 放在一起，component 是放入的部分

exampleSentences.en: I paused the video to improve my comprehension.
exampleSentences.zh: 我暫停影片，以便更好地理解內容。

exampleSentences.en: Reading comprehension depends on both vocabulary and background knowledge.
exampleSentences.zh: 閱讀理解同時取決於字彙與背景知識。

comprehension.mnemonicHint: com- 一起 + prehend 抓：把意思全部抓住就是理解。

exampleSentences.en: I checked the bill computations before asking everyone to split the cost.
exampleSentences.zh: 我先核對帳單上的計算，才請大家分攤費用。

exampleSentences.en: The researchers repeated the statistical computations to verify the reported mean.
exampleSentences.zh: 研究人員重做統計運算，以驗證報告中的平均值。

computations.mnemonicHint: compute 加 ation，完成計算的過程

exampleSentences.en: Water collected in the concave bottom of the dented pan.
exampleSentences.zh: 水積在凹陷鍋子的凹面底部。

exampleSentences.en: A concave lens caused the parallel light rays to diverge.
exampleSentences.zh: 凹透鏡使平行光線發散。

concave.mnemonicHint: cave 洞穴向內凹，concave 也是凹面

exampleSentences.en: Her text was concise but still sounded friendly.
exampleSentences.zh: 她的簡訊很簡潔，語氣卻仍然友善。

exampleSentences.en: A concise abstract should state the purpose, method, and principal findings.
exampleSentences.zh: 簡潔的摘要應說明研究目的、方法與主要發現。

concise.mnemonicHint: con 加 cise 切掉多餘，留下簡潔內容

exampleSentences.en: We sent a condolence card to our neighbor after her father died.
exampleSentences.zh: 鄰居的父親過世後，我們寄了一張慰問卡給她。

exampleSentences.en: The historian interprets the official message of condolence as a diplomatic gesture.
exampleSentences.zh: 歷史學家將這封官方慰唁文解讀為一種外交姿態。

condolence.mnemonicHint: con 一起加 dole 悲傷，共同哀悼

exampleSentences.en: I will not condone my son taking money from my wallet without asking.
exampleSentences.zh: 我不會縱容兒子未經同意就從我的錢包拿錢。

exampleSentences.en: Ethical guidelines cannot condone the deliberate concealment of adverse results.
exampleSentences.zh: 倫理準則不能容許研究者蓄意隱瞞不利結果。

condone.mnemonicHint: condone 不譴責，等於默許縱容

exampleSentences.en: Mina told only two trusted confidants that she planned to resign.
exampleSentences.zh: 米娜只把辭職的打算告訴兩位可信賴的知己。

exampleSentences.en: The biography draws on letters exchanged between the president and his closest confidants.
exampleSentences.zh: 這本傳記取材自總統與其最親近心腹之間往來的書信。

confidants.mnemonicHint: 向 confidant 有 confidence，能吐露秘密

exampleSentences.en: The teacher confiscated the student's phone during the exam.
exampleSentences.zh: 老師在考試期間沒收了學生的手機。

exampleSentences.en: Authorities may confiscate counterfeit goods at customs.
exampleSentences.zh: 當局可能在海關沒收仿冒商品。

confiscate.mnemonicHint: con + fisc(treasury) + ate → 收歸國庫 → 沒收

exampleSentences.en: The meeting ended without further conflict.
exampleSentences.zh: 會議在沒有進一步衝突的情況下結束。

exampleSentences.en: Resource scarcity can intensify conflict between neighboring states.
exampleSentences.zh: 資源短缺可能加劇鄰國之間的衝突。

conflict.mnemonicHint: con- 一起 + flict 打：碰在一起互打就是衝突。

exampleSentences.en: The new roommates chatted congenially while cooking their first dinner together.
exampleSentences.zh: 新室友第一次一起做晚餐時，親切融洽地聊著天。

exampleSentences.en: Although the scholars disagreed, they debated congenially and cited one another's evidence.
exampleSentences.zh: 儘管學者意見不同，他們仍友善地辯論，並引用彼此的證據。

congenially.mnemonicHint: con 加 genial 親切，表示和善相處

exampleSentences.en: He apologized after realizing the consequences of his careless joke.
exampleSentences.zh: 他意識到自己那句輕率玩笑的後果後便道了歉。

exampleSentences.en: The article evaluates the long-term consequences of replacing wetlands with housing.
exampleSentences.zh: 該文評估以住宅取代濕地所造成的長期後果。

consequences.mnemonicHint: consequences 是事情接續發生後留下的結果，常帶有負面語氣。

exampleSentences.en: He took a conservative approach to investing.
exampleSentences.zh: 他採取保守的投資方式。

exampleSentences.en: Conservative estimates suggest temperatures will rise by 1.5°C.
exampleSentences.zh: 保守估計全球溫度將上升1.5°C。

conservative.mnemonicHint: conserv(keep) + ative → 保持現狀 → 保守的

exampleSentences.en: Her explanation is consistent with what I saw.
exampleSentences.zh: 她的解釋與我看到的情況一致。

exampleSentences.en: The findings are consistent across age and income groups.
exampleSentences.zh: 研究結果在不同年齡與收入群體間一致。

consistent.mnemonicHint: con- 一起 + sist 站：站在一起所以一致。

exampleSentences.en: The bright red car was conspicuous in the parking lot.
exampleSentences.zh: 那輛鮮紅色的車在停車場很顯眼。

exampleSentences.en: Conspicuous consumption often signals social status rather than need.
exampleSentences.zh: 炫耀性消費通常代表社會地位而非需要。

conspicuous.mnemonicHint: con(together) + spic(look) + uous → 大家都在看 → 顯眼的

exampleSentences.en: We reduced our electricity consumption this month.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們這個月降低了用電量。

exampleSentences.en: High fuel consumption increases both costs and carbon emissions.
exampleSentences.zh: 高燃料消耗會同時增加成本與碳排放。

consumption.mnemonicHint: consume 消耗 + -tion 名詞字尾。

exampleSentences.en: Contact me when you arrive at the station.
exampleSentences.zh: 你到車站時聯絡我。

exampleSentences.en: Direct contact with infected animals increases transmission risk.
exampleSentences.zh: 直接接觸受感染動物會提高傳播風險。

contact.mnemonicHint: con- 一起 + tact 觸碰：接觸並建立聯絡。

exampleSentences.en: Industrial waste can contaminate nearby rivers.
exampleSentences.zh: 工業廢物可能汙染附近的河流。

exampleSentences.en: Cross-contamination in food processing poses serious health risks.
exampleSentences.zh: 食品加工中的交叉汙染構成嚴重的衛生風險。

contaminate.mnemonicHint: con + tamin(touch) + ate → 被壞東西碰到 → 汙染

exampleSentences.en: We should have a contingency plan in case of bad weather.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們應該有一個應對壞天氣的應急計劃。

exampleSentences.en: Effective risk management requires identifying potential contingencies.
exampleSentences.zh: 有效的風險管理需要識別潛在的突發事件。

contingency.mnemonicHint: con + ting(touch/happen) + ency → 可能碰到的事 → 突發事件

exampleSentences.en: The evidence contradicts the defendant's testimony.
exampleSentences.zh: 證據與被告的證詞矛盾。

exampleSentences.en: Studies that contradict each other make it difficult to draw conclusions.
exampleSentences.zh: 相互矛盾的研究使得難以得出結論。

contradict.mnemonicHint: contra(against) + dict(speak) → 反著說 → 反駁

exampleSentences.en: We chose a conventional oven instead of an air fryer.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們選了傳統烤箱，而不是氣炸鍋。

exampleSentences.en: Conventional farming methods may rely heavily on chemical fertilizers.
exampleSentences.zh: 傳統農法可能高度依賴化學肥料。

exampleSentences.en: Her convincing excuse persuaded the manager to waive the late fee.
exampleSentences.zh: 她那令人信服的理由說服經理免除滯納金。

exampleSentences.en: The essay presents convincing evidence that sleep improves memory consolidation.
exampleSentences.zh: 這篇論文提出有力證據，證明睡眠能改善記憶鞏固。

convincing.mnemonicHint: convince 能使人信服，convincing 有說服力

exampleSentences.en: The witness's testimony corroborated the victim's account.
exampleSentences.zh: 證人的證詞證實了受害者的說法。

exampleSentences.en: Multiple studies corroborate the link between sleep deprivation and cognitive decline.
exampleSentences.zh: 多項研究證實了睡眠不足與認知衰退之間的關聯。

corroborate.mnemonicHint: cor(together) + robor(strength) + ate → 加強證據 → 證實

exampleSentences.en: Corrugated cardboard provides extra strength for boxes.
exampleSentences.zh: 瓦楞紙板為箱子提供額外強度。

exampleSentences.en: Corrugated roofing is widely used due to its affordability.
exampleSentences.zh: 波紋屋頂因經濟實惠而廣泛使用。

corrugate.mnemonicHint: cor + rug(wrinkle) + ate → 起皺 → 波紋狀

exampleSentences.en: The repair will cost about two hundred dollars.
exampleSentences.zh: 這次維修大約要花兩百美元。

exampleSentences.en: The social cost of unemployment extends beyond lost income.
exampleSentences.zh: 失業的社會成本不只包括收入損失。

cost.mnemonicHint: cost 少了 a；別和 coast 海岸混淆。

exampleSentences.en: I counted on Mia to give me a ride home.
exampleSentences.zh: 我指望米雅載我回家。

exampleSentences.en: The economic forecast counted on consumer demand remaining stable.
exampleSentences.zh: 這項經濟預測以消費需求維持穩定為前提。

counted on.mnemonicHint: 把某人算進計畫，就是 counted on 他

exampleSentences.en: The market inspector spotted counterfeits by checking the labels on the handbags.
exampleSentences.zh: 市場稽查員檢查手提包標籤時，發現了仿冒品。

exampleSentences.en: The study tests whether consumers can distinguish counterfeits from genuine medicines.
exampleSentences.zh: 該研究測試消費者能否分辨偽藥與真藥。

counterfeits.mnemonicHint: counter 對著真品做假的仿製品

exampleSentences.en: Let us create a playlist for the trip.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們來為這趟旅行建立播放清單。

exampleSentences.en: Investment in infrastructure can create employment opportunities.
exampleSentences.zh: 基礎建設投資能創造就業機會。

create.mnemonicHint: cre- 生長 + ate 動詞：讓新事物生長出來。

exampleSentences.en: The credulous investor lost his savings to a pyramid scheme.
exampleSentences.zh: 輕信的投資者因龐氏騙局損失了積蓄。

exampleSentences.en: Credulous consumers are vulnerable to misleading advertisements.
exampleSentences.zh: 輕信的消費者容易受到誤導性廣告的影響。

credulous.mnemonicHint: cred(believe) + ulous → 太容易相信 → 輕信的

exampleSentences.en: Customers waited outside before the store opened.
exampleSentences.zh: 顧客在商店開門前於外面等候。

exampleSentences.en: Customers increasingly demand transparent information about product origins.
exampleSentences.zh: 顧客日益要求產品來源資訊透明。

customers.mnemonicHint: custom 習慣引申為固定來往的 customer 顧客。

exampleSentences.en: The school asked students to report cyberbullying.
exampleSentences.zh: 學校要求學生通報網路霸凌。

exampleSentences.en: Cyberbullying can produce lasting psychological harm among adolescents.
exampleSentences.zh: 網路霸凌可能對青少年造成長期心理傷害。

cyberbullying.mnemonicHint: cyber 網路 + bullying 霸凌，就是網路霸凌。

glosses.furrow: 犁溝（用犁耕作後地上留下的溝）；皺紋
glosses.obscure: 模糊的；晦澀的；鮮為人知的；遮蔽
